english.title: Veterinary surgeon fail to enter in a horse passport the details required in sections V, VI, VII or IX of the passport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a veterinary surgeon, failed to enter into a horse passport relating to **(..SPECIFY HORSE..) the details required in section **(..SPECIFY SECTION NUMBER..) of the passport, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS REQUIRED..)
